card.name: Linking words in academic prose
card.fires_on: Small linking words and commas (of, to, in, is, a comma) right after an abstract or scholarly noun in humanities, philosophy and education text. The next word is often a theory term or a name.

modes.label: Of/to/in after abstract noun
modes.description: A preposition follows a noun like relation, consideration, understanding or advocates.
modes.example: Philosophical consideration<< of>> some of the main moral problems of modern

modes.label: Comma or is after a subject
modes.description: A comma or verb follows a named group or figure, before a list or appositive names.
modes.example: Former presidents of Princeton and Harvard<<,>> William G. Bowen and Derek Bok

card.writes: It slightly favors abstract academic terms like representation, syntax, culture and algorithm as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in scholarly writing, where an abstract idea or a name comes next.
